method: eval/recall_eval.py — real pipeline (embedder + KNN + FTS + graph merge + scoring + confidence gate), 100-fact synthetic store, 30 paraphrase queries, 2 passes
floor_rationale: false-answer tops measured 0.42-0.44 at 100 facts, inside the old empty gap; 0.50 clears the lookalike band by ~0.06 and stays ~0.13 under the answerable minimum - better silent than false (see trust.py)
watch: stats()['recall']['abstention_rate'] - cumulative counter since install; a sustained rise means the floor, store, or embedder drifted
re_measure_when: any production store doubles its fact count, or the embedder changes (embedder-stamp guard fires)
history_note: pre-0.7.0 harness runs measured 6/30 abstain on an earlier corpus revision; corpus and gate both changed since (supersession-at-recall, sample-gating fix) - numbers are not comparable across that boundary

verified.what: re-measure after the recall-gate fix (BM25 no longer leaks into vector_score, keyword-only rows rescue-path corrected) - corpus numbers unchanged (raw 0.8222 / hit@1 0.8 / gated 0.7368, 15/30 abstain, deterministic x2); record stands
